text: The flake was a real race, not load: under 12-way load 2 of 12 runs failed. Causes (7.0.4): (1) two sync runs both created the same label and the loser got HTTP 409 'label exists' (Forgejo and GitLab; GitHub already tolerated it), failing that item; (2) a git commit of paths a concurrent writer had just committed failed with 'nothing to commit', aborting a sync round after it had taken its ids from the queue, so an item was never synced. Both fixed with tests; 24 of 24 stressed runs pass.
